name: CIAN Agro Industries & Infrastructure Limited
about: CIAN Agro Industries & Infrastructure Limited engages in the agro, healthcare, and infrastructure businesses in India and internationally. It provides refined soybean, groundnut, rice bran, and sunflower oils under the Amrutdhara brand; mango pulp under the CIAN Fresh brand; spices under the CIAN SPICES brand; healthcare products include nutritional supplement; and home-care products, which comprises detergent powder, handwash, and liquid dishwash under the NEU brand, as well as facial kits, shampoos, soaps, handwash, face washes and mask, revitalizing oil, cream, scrub, and moisturizers under the OIR brand. The company also offers agro products, including bio-fertilizers and micronutrients under the CIAN agro brand. In addition, it engages in the erection, development, commissioning, and refurbishment of industrial projects and other allied activities; and import and trading of aluminum scrap. The company was formerly known as Umred Agro Complex Limited and changed its name to CIAN Agro Industries & Infrastructure Limited in December 2015. CIAN Agro Industries & Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Nagpur, India.
